name: Cerner Transfer Center
use_note: Seed map from a field survey of the Cerner Transfer Center case form (Terra/React UI). Element ids contain random per-case hashes (e.g. sendingPhysicianName_WcOTwkpjlDP_0), so these selectors match stable id prefixes/suffixes instead of exact ids. Dropdowns, split date/time pickers, and unlabeled phone fields cannot be reliably targeted by CSS and must be completed manually or via the copy buttons.
